title: PatchObject null should reset to property default, not always remove
description: RFC 8620 5.3: null means 'set to the default value if specified for this property; otherwise, remove the property'. apply_patch_object always removes. Typed defaults (serde default) usually mask this on read; audit servers (tasks noted) for properties whose default is not 'absent'.
close_reason: serde defaults for spec-defaulted fields across mail/contacts/calendars/tasks/chat types; tests per server. Remaining gaps filed separately.
